turns.answer_text:
The dataset has no measurements between 718 and 900 MPa, and those boundary observations use different processing regimes. Direct interpolation between them would therefore create an unsupported hybrid recipe.

I used the measured 718 MPa recipe as the anchor. Across 95 repeated low-strength recipe families differing only in `TT`, the within-family relationship was:

\[
\Delta\text{fatigue strength} \approx -0.90698\,\Delta TT
\]

The median slope was `-0.90`, and 94 of 95 families showed the same direction. Keeping the anchor recipe unchanged and reducing `TT` from `490` to `399.6` gives:

\[
718 + 0.90698(490-399.6) \approx 799.99\text{ MPa}
\]

All proposed values are within the observed ranges. Because `TT=399.6` is outside the range observed for this particular process family, the result is a controlled one-variable extrapolation rather than a validated interpolation.

Final: NT=845, THT=845, THt=30, THQCr=8, CT=30, Ct=0, DT=30, Dt=0, QmT=30, TT=399.6, Tt=60, TCr=24, C=0.62, Si=0.29, Mn=0.88, P=0.026, S=0.007, Ni=0.05, Cr=0.75, Cu=0.12, Mo=0.03, RedRatio=796, dA=0.058, dB=0, dC=0.004

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
D=pd.read_csv('/work/b3_fatigue_target.csv')
features=[c for c in D if c not in ['target','TT']]
slopes=[]; pairs=[]
for key,g in D.groupby(features,dropna=False):
 if g.TT.nunique()>1:
  x=g.TT.to_numpy(); y=g.target.to_numpy()
  b=np.polyfit(x,y,1)[0]
  slopes.append(b)
  for i in range(len(g)):
   for j in range(i+1,len(g)):
    if x[i]!=x[j]: pairs.append((min(x[i],x[j]),max(x[i],x[j]),(y[j]-y[i])/(x[j]-x[i])))
print('groups',len(slopes),'slope stats',pd.Series(slopes).describe(percentiles=[.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95]).to_string())
print('\nby TT pair')
pd.set_option('display.max_rows',100)
print(pd.DataFrame(pairs,columns=['lo','hi','slope']).groupby(['lo','hi']).slope.agg(['count','mean','median','std','min','max']).round(4).to_string())
# within-group FE estimate
G=D.groupby(features,dropna=False)
xx=[]; yy=[]
for _,g in G:
 if len(g)>1:
  xx.extend((g.TT-g.TT.mean()).tolist()); yy.extend((g.target-g.target.mean()).tolist())
xx=np.array(xx); yy=np.array(yy); b=xx@yy/(xx@xx)
print('\nFE weighted slope',b,'N',len(xx))
# boot by group slopes mean/median CIs
rng=np.random.default_rng(4); s=np.array(slopes)
boots=np.array([np.median(rng.choice(s,len(s),replace=True)) for _ in range(10000)])
print('median bootstrap CI',np.quantile(boots,[.025,.5,.975]))
for slope in [np.median(s),b,-.9,-.95]: print('TT from 718 to 800 slope',slope,490+(800-718)/slope)
